title: Record of Ragnarok
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The gods of many world religions vote to end humanity, and the valkyrie Brunhilde wins a reprieve: thirteen one-on-one duels between gods and famous humans from history. Each fight decides humanity's survival (to verify).
life_message: A life of defiant human courage and dignity, even against the divine.

content.note: A tournament of one-on-one fights where human champions and their valkyrie weapons die if they lose (Wikipedia); Common Sense Media (anime, 15+) rates violence 'a lot', with dismemberment, decapitation, people skewered on a stake and giants eating people.
Trash talk and mild profanity likely (to verify).

dominant: Might makes right; Secular humanism; Pagan/occult (pantheon of gods)
